findings.evidence: "Registering a domain grants no trademark right. Under ICANN's UDRP..." introduces a general legal overview the model already knows, unlike the specific lookup and registry-response guidance.
findings.fix: Condense this step to the operational safeguards: require trademark screening in the relevant jurisdictions and product classes before purchase, and never infer legal safety from domain registration or a near-match. Omit the general UDRP primer.

findings.evidence: "Group candidates by naming direction, then give a ranked table" applies the brainstorming format unconditionally, although the description also supports a direct single-domain registration-status question.
findings.fix: Scope naming-direction groups and the full ranked table to brainstorming requests. For a single-domain status request, default to the status, lookup evidence, source and UTC time, plus purchase and legal caveats; generate alternatives only when requested.

findings.evidence: "Does not assert current availability without a live check" would pass an answer that calls BrightNest.com available after an RDAP lookup, contradicting the skill's unconditional prohibition on that claim.
findings.fix: Replace this assertion with one requiring that the response never calls the domain available, even after a lookup; uses the defined registration-status labels; and supplies the source and UTC check time whenever a lookup supports the classification.

findings.evidence: "WHOIS returned a record with a creation date" is the only positive WHOIS classification rule, while line 34 makes every other reply unverified. The advertised .de fallback therefore cannot recognize a registered DENIC record containing "Domain:" and "Status: connect" but no creation date.
findings.fix: Allow explicit, authoritative registry-specific registration records without requiring a creation date. Document the .de branch: a matching Domain field with Status: connect means registered; Status: free means not found in registry; restricted, throttled or otherwise inconclusive replies remain unverified.
